# PDF templates and reproducible documents

- Preserve the current template plus two restrained alternatives with logo/accent controls. Use shared snapshot data for preview, PDF, public view and email attachments.
- Provide actual downloadable PDFs with stable invoice/client filenames. Browser printing alone is not the finished download feature.
- Verify the renderer in Cloudflare Workers. Store versioned issued PDFs privately; later template/settings changes must not alter issued attachments.
- Support multi-page tables, long descriptions, repeated headers, page numbers, Unicode, currency precision and optional separate work breakdowns.
- Visually inspect representative rendered pages, including long invoices and all templates. Successful builds or HTTP responses do not prove layout correctness.
- Clearly mark drafts. Keep document styling independent of app dark mode and animations.
